name: recent_commits
description: Summarize the last N git commits in one call: one line per commit, "hash  date  subject  (author)". Input: {"count": 3} (default 3, max 50). Read-only — the argv is fixed to git log.
llm_description: List last N git commits, one line each: "hash date subject (author)". Input: {count} (default 3, max 50). Read-only.
